name: minimal
description: Identical to standard (identity and institution/device-operator removed, UIDs reissued, descriptive text kept), except: a generated, memorable pseudonym replaces both the patient name and patient ID, and the birth date is simply replaced with the study's own scan date rather than scrambled to a nearby year. This is the default sanitisation policy for workflows that later convert the output to NIfTI.

PatientName.note: The readable form of the generated subject label, in DICOM Surname^Firstname form (e.g. Abrahall^Gracious). PatientID and output names use the same pseudonym in filesystem-safe form (abrahall_gracious).

PatientBirthDate.note: Overrides standard's scramble_date: here the birth date is simply the study's own scan date, not an approximate real one.
